PDF Direct Volume Rendering
Direct Volume Rendering For the visualization of three-dimensional scalar fields, direct volume rendering has emerged as a leading, and often preferred, method. In rendering volumetric data directly, a participating medium is composed of semi-transparent material that can emit, transmit, and absorb light, thereby allowing one to "see through" (or see inside) the data.
